NASA is currently pushing ahead at a break neck pace researching everything that needs to be established for a Mars colony. There's no time for a 'potato publicity stunt'. One huge milestone will be the first crops grown on Mars - somewhat interestingly going back to what sparked the formation of SpaceX. The entire process is certainly going to end up highly publicized and they're going to want to make sure they get it right on the first try. While NASA's more conservative 20 years time frame for a man on Mars might seem like some distant event, optimal launch windows to Mars only occur about once every two years meaning a single failure can easily end up costing years of time. Think of it this way - 1 failure on the potatoes and they're going to end up blowing at least 4 years or 20% of their entire timeframe! In reality it'd actually be even more than that as well. They're going to want to test generations of the crops before giving it the rubber stamp as finding out the plants have trouble reproducing after 5 generations in Martian soil would be troublesome when you're relying on that for food and you're a hundred million miles from Earth.

It was me, I was an idiot and I deserve all the mocking that came with it. Before I explain what happened and why, I'd like to make it my first priority to offer a few direct apologies for lying. I lied because I was embarrassed. You may think I was embarrassed by the attention in /v/Whatever, and I was, but the real truth is more embarrassing and deserving of even more mockery. I apologize to @LaBeerHen and to @kevdude for lying to them directly. I apologize to the mods of v/Meanwhile for not coming clean with them and leaving them to try and defend my actions.

With that said, here's what happened:

Early Saturday, I got up and started working on my indie game and checked into voat to see if anything interesting was going on. I also poured myself some cheap whiskey and downed it. I'm not using the fact that I was drunk as an excuse, but I'd be lying if I said it played no role. I noticed almost all of my submissions to /v/Meanwhile had taken 9-12 downvoats overnight. I'm used to getting some hate, but this didn't fit the usual pattern. Most of those threads had already stabilized. Some were in the negative and some in the positive. Someone had clearly gone through and brigaded my threads, most likely with sock puppets.

Some people think there is a real animosity between me and kevdude, but I don't think there is. At least not on my part. That's not hard to admit here. For the most part, I stay out of his way unless he's taking up some action that I think will infringe on my ability to run my own private subs, or unless he's talking about me directly. If it's that last one, I'll really throw some elbows. Regardless, the part that's hard to admit is that after seeing my threads brigaded Saturday, I privately asked him for help. It made sense at the time. He has a larger active group, and he's probably dealt with this before. Also, I wanted to feel him out and see if he thought anyone in his sub might be behind it. He gave me some advice. I won't share his words without his consent, but let's just say that I was still drinking, and in my state of self-induced lowered IQ, I completely corrupted his advice into my own terrible plan and executed it in the dumbest possible way.

I'm not even completely sure what may goal was by the time I made the now infamous AnonTalk post. I was fairly hammered by then. I think I was trying to draw out the downvoat brigade and figure out who was doing it. I couldn't do that over there, only stoke the fires, so I also cross posted to /v/whatever. I made this post: https://voat.co/v/whatever/comments/735089 with the top link the one I had just created. I don't know who posted the other 3, but I don't blame you if you don't believe me on that one. I don't have any reason to hide it if I did, now that I'm coming clean.

Here's the part that gets really embarrassing. I was outed by my own L2 mods of /v/Meanwhile. One of them noticed the AnonTalk thread and linked to it in my sub, so we could make fun of it. That's right, the whole fire started IN MY OWN DAMNED SUB. Another jumped into the anon thread and started making fun of the IDIOT posting the thread because they could see [s] next to the posts. They had no idea they were arguing with ME, and at that point, I didn't know I was arguing with my own L2 mod. The timeline gets fuzzy for me here because I was pretty hammered. At some point, I was taking a nap, sleeping off some of the drink. I think the nap may have been around this time because had I been awake, I would have put out the fire as quickly as I could. But I didn't get that chance. After my L2 outed me, the whole thing blew up fast.

At that point, I was in damage control, trying to play it off because I was completely embarrassed. I lied about it and I tried in vain to cover it up.

I think a couple of things have been established here and some good came from it though.

One, I'm not embarrassed by it anymore. If I let stupid things like this bother me, I'm losing focus on the rest of my life. I spent Sunday mostly avoiding voat and working on my indie game. I got a LOT done that I otherwise would not have, had I been on here worrying about voats.
